$\frac{864}{16+t} = 48$.
Multiplying both sides by $16+t$, we get
$864 = 48(16+t)$
$864 = 48 \cdot 16 + 48t$
$864 = 768 + 48t$
$864 - 768 = 48t$
$96 = 48t$
$t = \frac{96}{48} = 2$ hours.

$$ 677 \times 6 = 2415 + x $$
$$ 4062 = 2415 + x $$

$$ x = 1647 $$
